canonical_title: The early manhood of Prophet Muhammad
question: What job did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ do as a young man before prophethood?
answer: He worked as a shepherd, tending the sheep of the people of Makkah for a small wage.
supporting_quote: I used to be a shepherd. I used to tend to the flock of the people of Mecca in return for some qararit

canonical_title: The early manhood of Prophet Muhammad
question: What was the main reason the lecturer gave for rejecting the story of Buhayrah the monk?
answer: He said the story has historical and content problems, including impossible details like Abu Bakr and Bilal being present at that time.
supporting_quote: the story mentions in one version that Abu Bakr was accompanying the Prophet ﷺ. And in another version it says that Bilal was the slave of the caravan.

canonical_title: The early manhood of Prophet Muhammad
question: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about the treaty of Hilf al-Fudul?
answer: He said he witnessed a treaty in the house of Abdullah ibn Jud'an that he would uphold even in Islam.
supporting_quote: I witnessed in the house of Abdullah ibn Jud'an a treaty that were I asked to uphold it even in Islam, I would do so.

canonical_title: Zayd b. Harithah & Beginning of Revelation
question: Why did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ leave the matter of Zayd ibn Harithah to Zayd himself when Zayd’s father came to reclaim him?
answer: Because the Prophet ﷺ did not want to force Zayd to leave; he gave Zayd the choice to stay with him or return with his father and uncle.
supporting_quote: I will leave the matter to him. And if he chooses you, then I will send him back without any ransom.

canonical_title: Zayd b. Harithah & Beginning of Revelation
question: What did Khadijah say to reassure the Prophet ﷺ after the first revelation?
answer: She told him that Allah would never humiliate him because of his good character and good deeds.
supporting_quote: Allah will never humiliate you Allah will never do anything to cause you harm

canonical_title: Zayd b. Harithah & Beginning of Revelation
question: What was the first revelation that Jibreel brought to the Prophet ﷺ in the cave of Hira?
answer: The first revelation was the opening verses of Surah al-‘Alaq, beginning with “Iqra’ bismi rabbika alladhi khalaq.”
supporting_quote: اقْرَأْ بِسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ

question: According to the lecture, from where did the Prophet ﷺ begin the Isra journey?
answer: He began from the Ka'bah area in Makkah, specifically the Hatim, according to the most authentic version.
supporting_quote: while I was sleeping in Al-Hateem. What is Al-Hateem? It is the semi-circular region that is outside of the Ka'bah.

question: Which prophets did the lecturer say were in the second heaven?
answer: Yahya and Isa were in the second heaven.
supporting_quote: In the second heaven, there is Yahya and Isa, Ibneya al-Khal, i.e. their two mothers were sisters

question: What did the Prophet ﷺ choose when given milk and wine, and what did Jibreel say about that choice?
answer: He chose the milk, and Jibreel said he had chosen the fitrah.
supporting_quote: The Prophet ﷺ chose the milk, and Jibreel says, you have chosen the fitrah.

canonical_title: Change of the Qiblah & Abrogation in Qur'an
question: When did the change of qiblah likely occur after the Hijrah?
answer: It likely occurred about 15–16 months after the Hijrah, around Rajab or Sha'ban of the second year.
supporting_quote: The change of qibla occurs. And the change of qibla probably occurred around 15-16 months after the immigration.

canonical_title: Change of the Qiblah & Abrogation in Qur'an
question: What was the first major ruling that was abrogated in this lecture's discussion?
answer: The first major abrogation discussed was the change of qiblah, from facing Bayt al-Maqdis to facing Masjid al-Haram.
supporting_quote: The first time abrogation occurred, we'll talk about it today, that is the Qibla.

canonical_title: Change of the Qiblah & Abrogation in Qur'an
question: Who was the most famous inhabitant of Ahl al-Suffah mentioned in the lecture?
answer: Abu Hurairah was the most famous inhabitant of Ahl al-Suffah.
supporting_quote: I already said that the most famous inhabitant of the Sufah was Abu Hurairah.

question: What happened in the expedition called Qarqaratul Qadr, and why did the Muslims gain so much booty there?
answer: A small pagan force fled when the Muslims approached, leaving behind tents, belongings, and animals, which the Muslims captured as booty.
supporting_quote: when they saw the Muslims coming, they fled and they left all of their tents and their booty and their belongings

question: Why is the expedition called the Battle of Sawiq?
answer: It is called the Battle of Sawiq because the Quraysh cut off and abandoned their bags of dried porridge, or sawiq, while fleeing.
supporting_quote: they cut off the bags of sawiq. They cut off the bags of sawiq, and that is why the battle is called the battle of sawiq.

question: What was Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf's final major offense before his killing, according to the lecture?
answer: He began composing sensual, mocking poetry about Muslim women, which the lecturer describes as the final straw.
supporting_quote: he starts writing, how should we say this? Sensual poetry about Muslim ladies. i.e. basically erotic poetry

question: Why did the Prophet Muhammad go to the Banu Nadir in the first place?
answer: He went to ask them to help pay the blood money for the accidental killing connected to the incident of Bi'r Ma'una.
supporting_quote: Because he wants help in paying the blood money for something that is common for the entire city of Medina.

question: What did the Banu Nadir plan to do when the Prophet sat near their fortress?
answer: They planned to drop a rock on him from the top of the fortress and assassinate him.
supporting_quote: let us go to the top and we can and that's how they protect fortresses they have their big items they have their rocks all of this is prepared

question: How did Surah Al-Hashr describe the wealth taken from the Banu Nadir?
answer: It said the wealth was not gained by fighting, but was given by Allah as fay and distributed to the needy and the Prophet.
supporting_quote: فَمَا أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ You did not spur your horses and your camels.

question: What did the Prophet ﷺ tell Abu Jandal when he was returned to Mecca?
answer: He told him to be patient and that Allah would make a way out for him.
supporting_quote: be patient O Abu Jandal for Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta'ala will make a way and an exit out for you

question: What did the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah stipulate about fighting between the two sides?
answer: It established a ten-year peace in which neither side would fight.
supporting_quote: there would be a peace for 10 years. For 10 years, neither side would fight.

question: What did the Prophet ﷺ do after the Muslims finally woke up from missing Fajr on the way back?
answer: He moved the group away from that place and then they prayed Fajr there.
supporting_quote: let us get away from this place, because shaitan has caused us to miss fajr, so let's go a little bit further.

question: Which two tribes were allied with the Quraysh and the Muslims after Hudaybiyah, respectively?
answer: Banu Bakr allied with the Quraysh, and Khuza'ah allied with the Muslims.
supporting_quote: The tribe of Khuza'ah and the tribe of Banu Bakr. The tribe of Khuza'ah and the tribe of Banu Bakr.

question: What did the Prophet ﷺ tell the Khuza'ah after hearing Amr ibn Salim's poem?
answer: He promised that they would be helped.
supporting_quote: the Prophet ﷺ was moved by the poetry and he said that you shall be helped Ya Amr ibn Salim, Satunsar, you shall be helped.

question: How many people did the Prophet ﷺ gather under his banner for the march to Mecca?
answer: He gathered over 10,000 people.
supporting_quote: until eventually the Prophet ﷺ gathered over 10,000 people under his banner

question: What did Ka'b do when he heard the good news that his repentance had been accepted?
answer: He fell into sajdah in gratitude.
supporting_quote: I fell down in sajda. Realizing that Allah's help had come.

question: What did the Prophet ﷺ tell Ka'b to do with his wealth after his repentance was accepted?
answer: He told him to keep some wealth for himself and his family rather than giving everything away.
supporting_quote: Keep some of your wealth with you that is better for you. Don't give everything.

question: What did the lecturer say about the meaning of the Qur'anic phrase "wa 'ala ath-thalathati alladhina khullifu"?
answer: He said it means the three were placed in suspension and their verdict was not yet decided, not simply that they remained behind.
supporting_quote: our verdict was suspended we were in limbo that's what he is saying

question: What did the Prophet ﷺ tell people to do regarding the rites of Hajj?
answer: He told them to take their Hajj rites from him.
supporting_quote: خُذُ عَنِّي مَنَاسِكَكُمْ خُذُ عَنِّي مَنَاسِكَكُمْ Take your rights of hajj from me

question: What verse was revealed during the standing at Arafah?
answer: The verse was: اليوم أكملت لكم دينكم وأتممت عليكم نعمتي ورضيت لكم الإسلام دينا.
supporting_quote: اليوم أكملت لكم دينكم وأتممت عليكم نعمتي ورضيت لكم الإسلام دينا that today I have completed your religion for you

question: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about the Book of Allah in his farewell sermon?
answer: He said that as long as people hold on to the Book of Allah, they will never go astray.
supporting_quote: the Kitabullah, the book of Allah, Jalaluhu. So this was the khutbat al-wada'
